purchased_product.camera_instruction: Install a camera with the corresponding size directly, or use an adapter for other cameras.
purchased_product.package_evidence: The official RoArm-M3-Pro package image lists the arm, accessory pack, 12 V 5 A supply, expansion mounting plate, camera holder, EoAT expansion plate, and base mounting plate. It does not list a camera.

selected_candidate.selection_basis: Official module drawing exactly matches the bundled holder hole-center pattern. This is an engineering selection, not a claim that Waveshare includes or explicitly names this camera on the standalone arm page.

controller_distinction.arm_transport: USB serial newline JSON at 115200 baud
controller_distinction.camera_transport: Separate USB video through OpenCV after the selected camera is acquired
controller_distinction.rule: The arm controller and camera are separate devices and transports. Never treat the RoArm ESP32 HTTP or USB command interface as a camera stream.

esp_http_mjpeg.purpose: Support a separately purchased and physically identified ESP camera only
required_identity: MAC address or other persistent identity
base URL plus status, snapshot, and stream endpoints
resolution, frame format, frame sequence, and timestamp behavior
adapter drawing, power source, mass/CG, and moving cable route
esp_http_mjpeg.mechanical_rule: A Waveshare/Ai-Thinker ESP32-CAM is 40.5 x 27 mm and does not match the direct 21 x 13.5 mm holder pattern; it needs a controlled adapter. It is not included or named by the standalone RoArm product page.

calibration_contract.timing_policy: Use settled stop-and-look capture until a device exposure timestamp is proven synchronized to arm joint feedback. Host receipt time alone cannot qualify in-motion visual correction.

required_evidence: clear front and back photographs of the delivered camera board and holder
USB descriptors and enumerated capture modes
installed holder/rail position and fastener record
camera, holder, connector, and cable mass/CG

official_sources.supports: Bundled/open-source camera holder, upper-arm 1020 rails, boat-nut/M4 peripheral mounting, and onboard ESP32 controller distinction
Selected candidate identity, USB interface, sensor/lens, video modes, module envelope, and exact 21 x 13.5 mm mounting pattern
Separate ESP32-CAM/OV2640 product identity and 40.5 x 27 x 4.5 mm board envelope
